scope: P1-A64a classic Cheng Pu Lihuo direct-play runtime without publishing an incomplete general
selectedVersion: 一将成名2012经典程普疠火

sources.use: 一将成名官方武将页冻结经典疠火文本：普通杀可改为火杀，以此法使用且造成过伤害后失去1点体力；使用火杀可多选择一个目标。
官方历史问答用于区分转换来源和结算边界：疠火转换为可选；全部目标闪避时不失去体力；朱雀羽扇转换不是疠火转换，因此不会触发失去体力。
按用户指定概念页区分持久状态规则与需确认触发：疠火的牌名修改、目标数修改和用牌后条件结算建模为State规则，不生成独立主动技能按钮。
伤害流程用于锁定‘造成过伤害’边界：只有实际伤害落地才累计本次用牌的伤害事实，被防止或全部闪避不计。

ruleText: 你使用普通的〖杀〗可以改为火〖杀〗，若此〖杀〗造成过伤害，你失去1点体力；你使用火〖杀〗可以多选择一个目标。

implementation.directPlayScope: native Slash/Fire Slash/Thunder Slash plus existing play-phase Slash conversion actions
implementation.modifierModel: LegalAction and PlayCardCommand independently preserve card-kind and target-count modifiers, so Lihuo conversion, Zhuque conversion, and Lihuo extra-target provenance cannot be conflated
implementation.penaltyTiming: after the complete Slash use finishes; once per use and only when the Lihuo card-kind conversion caused at least one actual damage

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: accepted commands preserve exact conversion provenance, target extension and post-use HP loss under rules v113
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: rules v112 disables formal Lihuo even when package 1.91.0 is present; package 1.90.0 does not register the skill

assertions: an ordinary Slash exposes both its original action and a distinct Lihuo Fire Slash action
any effective Fire Slash can add exactly one target beyond the current Slash target ceiling
a Lihuo-converted multi-target Slash that deals damage loses exactly one HP after the whole card use
native Fire Slash and Zhuque-converted Fire Slash gain the extra target but never pay the Lihuo conversion penalty
a fully dodged Lihuo conversion does not lose HP
forged modifier provenance is rejected atomically and a completed branch replays exactly

deferred: Chunlao runtime and the complete Cheng Pu general registration
WPF presentation and official portrait acceptance for the complete general
non-direct Slash request pipelines such as Borrowed Sword or acquired cross-general skills
full WPF suite, intentionally skipped because no Cheng Pu general or presentation was published in this runtime-only block
real Windows desktop and multi-DPI acceptance
